thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx rates and p99 latency for Hosted API + several Dedicated pools in eu-south-1. 5xx rate up ~18% over baseline, p99 latency ~3.2s. Sources: api-gateway, lb, and auth proxy. Link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/2140005555 :rotating_light:

Priya (oncall): acked. paging eng-sre and runtime. putting channel into high-priority. Anyone seeing related PagerDuty?

Alice SRE: looking. Confirming a cluster of ELB errors in eu-south-1, 503/504s from upstream control plane. Not tied to our app errors yet, but auth proxy is timing out on STS calls.

Marco (eng-runtime): seeing increased retries in model-serving layer where KV cache fetches = timeout -> cascade. Logs showing repeated errors: `error: upstream 504 from sts.amazonaws.com`

Laura (eng-infra): AWS console shows region-level increased API latencies. Filed AWS ticket (case 123456789). AWS status page (automated): https://status.aws/incident/xxxx - they're reporting "regional control plane API throttling" for eu-south-1.

Dana (support): any customer-facing regressions? Which customers hit Dedicated pools in this region?

Marco (eng-runtime): Dedicated pools eu-south-1 are hitting high tail latencies, some requests escalate to 5xx because auth fails before token attach. Hosted API traffic with region affinity is affected.

Priya (oncall): declaring Sev2 (customer impact but partial). Triage plan: 1) enable regional fallback to route new Hosted API requests to eu-west-1 where possible, 2) migrate Dedicated routing policy to prefer alternate region for new connections, 3) throttle/buffer retries at edge to avoid thundering herd, 4) contact Sales/CS for high-touch customers.

Alice SRE: implementing routing change now. Running command: ```
# switch fallback policy for eu-south-1
redwoodctl routing update --region eu-south-1 --fallback eu-west-1 --enable
```

Laura (eng-infra): also adding temporary rate limit on internal auth proxy for region to avoid saturating STS: ```kubectl -n infra patch deploy auth-proxy --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rlimit":"2000r/s"}}}}}'```

Marco (eng-runtime): can we spin extra Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 for hot customers? We have reserved pools but need to divert traffic.

Priya (oncall): yes, request sent to autoscale group. Laura, can you confirm cluster autoscaler will pick up new nodes?

Laura (eng-infra): autoscaler triggered, provisioning GPUs in eu-west-1, ETA ~6 min. I'll watch for node joins.

Dana (support): notifying customers currently with jobs in eu-south-1: AcmeCorp, LexiHealth, and Forumly. Sending a short status note and mitigation steps. Template: "We're seeing elevated errors in eu-south-1; we have temporarily routed new requests to eu-west-1. Ongoing work to restore normal operations. No action required from you unless you see errors."

John (product): Can we confirm any data plane consistency issues from reroute? Need to check sticky sessions / KV cache key locality.

Marco (eng-runtime): model KV caches will be cold in fallback region; expect increased latency for first few requests but correctness unaffected. We'll warm critical prefixes for top customers. Command to warm prefix: ```
warm-client-cache --customer AcmeCorp --region eu-west-1 --models tiny/medium
```

incident-bot: Update: routing update applied. ~42% of new Hosted API sessions in eu-south-1 now redirected to eu-west-1.

Priya (oncall): good. Monitor error rates and SLOs. Alice, keep tracing for auth timeouts. Marco, coordinate cache warm. Laura, confirm nodes backfilled. Dana, keep customer comms and capture any escalations.

Alice SRE: auth proxy timeout metric dropping after rlimit change, but STS timeouts still intermittent. Looks like AWS control plane is partially throttled.

Marco (eng-runtime): warming caches for AcmeCorp and Forumly now. Will post warm completion.

Laura (eng-infra): nodes joined in eu-west-1, Dedicated pools are healthy. Autoscale logs: `node/gpu-12 joined`

Dana (support): customer note posted to affected list and support queue. AcmeCorp says some long-running sessions aborted, asking for ETA.

Priya (oncall): ETA depends on AWS recovery. AWS status showing "investigating". We're keeping routing in place for at least 30m and will update statuspage. Declaring incident timeline and assigning owner for postmortem: Alice and Marco.

Alice SRE: handing pager to Priya's night shift at 2140005800 for monitoring and follow-up, handing summary: routing fallback enabled, rate-limited auth proxy, autoscaled eu-west-1, cache warming in progress, customers notified.

Priya (oncall): ack handoff. Taking over monitoring. Next steps: 1) maintain fallback, 2) if AWS recovers, gradually shift traffic back with canary, 3) confirm no data loss, 4) root cause follow-up with AWS ticket.

Marco (eng-runtime): cache warm done for AcmeCorp and Forumly. Observed p99 down to ~800ms for warmed requests in eu-west-1.

incident-bot: METRICS: overall 5xx now reduced to +6% over baseline; p99 ~1.1s. Still elevated vs normal.

Dana (support): noted. Customers ACKed message, AcmeCorp requests credit for aborted sessions. Escalating to CS/finance.

John (product): set internal comms for enterprise customers and page account reps. Also add note to statuspage: "Partial service degradation in eu-south-1; mitigation in place (fallback to eu-west-1)."
